name: Death Academy
source:
Your first day at the Death Academy has just begun, and you are an impostor — a lost soul that crawled back to life. You need aid, alliances… luckily, you notice three stunning gods you can charm.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
你在死亡学院的第一天才刚刚开始，你是一个冒名顶替者——一个复活的迷失灵魂。你需要援助、联盟……幸运的是，你注意到可以迷惑三位令人惊叹的神。

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用程序[/url]]
